notes: Fixed author version method reproduction, not identical paper hardware/model.
All configured random-wrench outcomes retained. Means cover each episode's observed duration, not a common full-task horizon.
The paper's 0.12/0.14/0.08 Mean Cost has no fully specified scalar definition; these metrics are explicitly defined.
scope: Fixed author-version R1 method reproduction with dated Aliengo physics; all 205 configured restored-foothold episodes completed. Not certified as the original 2024 release.
execution_commands: python scripts/run_tm01_r1.py --experiment table1 --method METHOD --device gpu --run r1-foothold-restored --config experiments/tm01/r1-foothold-restored.json --timing-context shared-throughput (METHOD: acados, naive, adaptive_fixed, adaptive; sequential)

python scripts/run_tm01_r1.py --experiment fig3 --method METHOD --device gpu --run r1-foothold-restored --config experiments/tm01/r1-foothold-restored.json --timing-context shared-throughput (METHOD: acados, naive, mppi; sequential)

python scripts/run_tm01_r1.py --experiment fig4 --method METHOD --device gpu --run r1-foothold-restored --config experiments/tm01/r1-foothold-restored.json --timing-context shared-throughput (METHOD: acados, adaptive; sequential)
remaining_gap: A confirmed swing-clock discontinuity remains in this deliberately unchanged clock condition. The complete paired clock-repaired experiment uses its own configuration and new trajectories; it is not yet an established improvement.
supported: All three base controllers complete the common 60 s +/-5 N/Nm tracking experiment; acados has the lowest measured velocity error in this one declared seed.
Under 40 N world-y push at 2-5 s, adaptive frequency increases after 2.04 s and returns permanently to nominal after 5.54 s; RMSE is lower than acados.
With the same adaptive implementation, permitting frequency changes raises full 60 s completion from 0/50 to 17/50 and mean time without a fall from 8.09216 to 38.02248 s.
The joint foothold restoration improves adaptive completion from 7/50 to 17/50 on the same 50 seeds. Its two constituent changes are not separately identified.
not_reproduced: The paper Figure 4 acados fall: both controllers survive this explicitly declared reconstruction.
The paper Table I percentages 32/37/80 and undefined Mean Cost: duration, complete disturbance schedule and scoring were not published.
Isolated relative algorithm speed ranking: measured times include a concurrent training workload, accepted for continued execution by the user.
Original Aliengo real-robot experiments remain unperformed.
